title: Nestlé reaches agreement to divest its mainstream vitamins, minerals and supplements business
author: Nestlé
description: Nestlé has agreed to sell its mainstream Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) business, including seven established brands such as Nature's Bounty and Puritan's Pride, to Yellow Wood Partners for USD 1.0 billion. The transaction is expected to close by the first half of 2027. Nestlé will focus on premium, science-led VMS brands like Solgar and Pure Encapsulations, where it has stronger competitive advantages.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The divestment is presented as a strategic move to focus resources on higher-margin, premium VMS brands where Nestlé has stronger competitive advantages. This portfolio optimization and focus on science-led premium segments aligns with value creation and improved operational efficiency.
